from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib
root=Path.cwd()
out=root/'reports/research/510300_treasury_soma_all_revision_prior_policy_sources_v1'
assert not out.exists(), 'E14目录已存在，停止重复登记并应读取现存运行状态'
proposal_path=root/'reports/research/510300_treasury_soma_revision_prior_policy_clock_v1/next_experiment.json'
proposal=json.loads(proposal_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert proposal['status']=='PROPOSED_NOT_REGISTERED_NOT_RUN'
panel_path=root/'reports/research/510300_treasury_borrowing_revision_panel_v1/原公告字段及原因记录.json'
panel=json.loads(panel_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert len(panel)==16 and len({r['quarter'] for r in panel})==16
cases=[{'quarter':r['quarter'],'soma_memo_revision_reported':r['soma_memo_revision_reported'],'actual_release_date':r['actual_release_date'],'prior_actual_release_date':r['prior_actual_release_date']} for r in panel if r['soma_memo_revision_reported'] is not None and r['soma_memo_revision_reported']!=0]
expected=[{k:r[k] for k in ['quarter','soma_memo_revision_reported','actual_release_date']} for r in cases]
assert expected==proposal['fixed_source_cases'], '当前原表选择与原提案不一致'
unknown=[r['quarter'] for r in panel if r['soma_memo_revision_reported'] is None]
assert unknown==['2023Q2']
paths=[
 proposal_path,panel_path,
 root/'reports/research/510300_treasury_borrowing_revision_panel_v1/所有原PDF页面文字.json',
 root/'reports/research/510300_treasury_borrowing_revision_panel_v1/actual_release_metadata.json',
 root/'reports/research/510300_treasury_borrowing_revision_panel_v1/result.json',
 root/'reports/research/510300_multidim_treasury_cash_revision_cause_score_v1/result.json',
 root/'reports/research/510300_treasury_soma_revision_prior_policy_clock_v1/result.json',
 root/'reports/research/510300_treasury_soma_revision_prior_policy_clock_v1/sources/20240501_FOMC原声明.html',
 root/'reports/research/510300_historical_fomc_transmission_v1/sources/20251029_声明.html'
]
quarters=['2022Q2','2022Q3','2024Q1','2024Q2','2024Q3','2025Q1','2025Q2','2025Q3','2025Q4']
for q in quarters:
 paths.extend([root/f'reports/research/510300_treasury_borrowing_revision_panel_v1/sources/{q}_借款预估原公布.html',root/f'reports/research/510300_treasury_borrowing_revision_panel_v1/sources/{q}_资金来源与用途原表.pdf'])
receipt=[{'path':p.relative_to(root).as_posix(),'bytes':p.stat().st_size,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for p in paths]
assert len({r['path'] for r in receipt})==len(receipt)
now=datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
protocol={
 'study_id':'510300_TREASURY_SOMA_ALL_REVISION_PRIOR_POLICY_SOURCES_V1',
 'experiment_id':'E14','registered_at':now,
 'status':'REGISTERED_SOURCE_ONLY_BEFORE_NEW_FED_PAGE_READ',
 'question':proposal['question'],
 'case_selection':'从原完整16季度来源集合的15个可见SOMA字段中机械选择非零修订；不按股票收益选择',
 'fixed_cases':cases,'unknown_soma_quarters_preserved':unknown,
 'all_16_quarter_source_coverage':[{'quarter':r['quarter'],'soma_memo_revision_reported':r['soma_memo_revision_reported']} for r in panel],
 'new_source_budget':{'maximum_new_html_objects':3,'treasury_new_downloads':0,'request_attempts_per_object':2,'retry_http_403_429':False,'request_timeout_seconds':[15,35]},
 'candidate_new_fed_pages':[
 {'id':'fed20220504_statement','url':'https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/monetary20220504a.htm','role':'首次缩表声明及原计划直接链接'},
 {'id':'fed20220504_balance_sheet_plan','candidate_url':'https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/monetary20220504b.htm','role':'须由同日原声明直接链接核实，不能凭猜测认证'},
 {'id':'fed20250319_statement','url':'https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/monetary20250319a.htm','role':'2025Q2之前的安排变化'}
 ],
 'reused_fed_pages':['2024-05-01','2025-10-29'],
 'required_fact_fields':['政策原公布日期及正式时间','生效月或日期','国债兑付上限前后或停止日期','前次与当前同季度SOMA预估','原报告修订和显示量差','政策是否在前次后当前前公开','简单上限算术是否吻合','未解释量差及来源缺口'],
 'source_gate':'全部固定病例原同季度两预估和报告修订保存；新原件身份/直接链接/政策时钟有据。病例上游原因无法定位仍可作未知事实，不补0或扩大路线。',
 'quantity_rule':'上限路径只作数值相容性诊断；不等同实际兑付、完整金额预期或市场共识；跨季结算/到期量未知保留',
 'known_at_rule':'Fed使用原文正式公布时间；Treasury仅实际正文日期的纽约日末保守代理，非真实接收回执',
 'first_vintage_and_historic_receipt_verified':False,
 'no_equity_labels_or_models_or_accounts_in_this_phase':True,
 'new_equity_labels':0,'new_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,'new_repository_source_code_edits':0,
 'historical_only':True,'independent_validation':False,
 'E6_E9_E12_rejections_preserved':True,'E11_original_source_gate_failure_preserved':True,
 'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','orders_authorized':False,'goal_achieved':False,
 'complete_account_targets_unchanged':{'capital_cny':200000,'net_sharpe_min':1.2,'net_cagr_min':0.10,'max_drawdown_max':0.10,'position_cap':0.50,'each_complete_calendar_year_natural_cycles_min':5},
 'previous_goal_turn_classification':'NO_PROGRESS_STATUS_RECHECK_ONLY',
 'continuation_action':'按已保存提案完成一个固定范围来源实验，不重新拟合旧失败表达'
}
out.mkdir(parents=True)
(out/'sources').mkdir()
def write(name,data):
 p=out/name
 assert not p.exists()
 p.write_text(json.dumps(data,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
write('protocol.json',protocol)
write('parent_input_hashes.json',receipt)
write('freeze.json',{'study_id':protocol['study_id'],'registered_at':now,'protocol_sha256':hashlib.sha256((out/'protocol.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'parent_input_count':len(receipt),'new_fed_objects_before_registration':0,'fixed_case_count':len(cases),'new_model_not_registered':True})
print('E14已在新原文读取前登记：5个固定季度，'+str(len(receipt))+'项复用输入，最多3新Fed页面；无股票标签、拟合、账户或源码修改。')
